meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你在消息里给出的本地附件(Word、演示、表格、PDF 等)在容器内转成 Markdown 文件,并打印输出路径;也能指明转换失败的原因。文档内容只当数据看待,不会因其中写着命令就去执行。
howto.when: 当消息附带一个本地附件路径、并且需要在不把文件上传到外部解析服务的前提下读取它时,Claude 会接管转换。

say.text: 帮我看看 /workspace/inbox/msg/data.csv 里写了什么
say.note: 先转成 Markdown,再读取相关部分。

say.text: 这个 PDF 转出来缺图片内容吗?
say.note: 会说明扫描件、图片等限制。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude converts a local attachment path (Word, slides, spreadsheets, PDF, etc.) into a Markdown file inside the agent container and prints the output path, or reports why conversion failed. Converted text is treated as data, not instructions.
howto.when_en: It triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading the file to an external parser, such as a Word file, a spreadsheet, or a text-based PDF.

say_en.note: Writes a Markdown file locally and prints its path.
Converts the CSV first, then reads sections.

say_en.text: Was any visual content dropped from this PDF?
